tts: Moving money across chains shouldn't take five tabs, three bridges, and a prayer.
Every route has a different price. And you never really know if you got the best one.
Rift fixes that. Pick what you have. Pick what you want. Rift finds the best price, in one click.
Behind that click, Rift routes across twenty-plus venues on eight chains, finding the best price at every step.
Every order gets its own deposit address. And if a venue goes down mid-route, Rift tries every other venue for that step.
Bitcoin, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, and more. Zero added fees.
Rift. Best price execution, in one click.
